segments.title: Repo Madness Gaming Session
segments.notes: Case Blackwell hosts an extended cooperative gaming session of R.E.P.O. with Kendelle, his brother Nathan, and friends, troubleshooting mods and hardware issues throughout.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: Anchors an impromptu three-hour gaming stream, managing invites, mods, and technical crises while playing R.E.P.O. with guests.

characters.name: Pepito
characters.notes: executive producer. Delivers the cold-open sign-on as 'Papita' before yielding the broadcast to Case.

characters.name: Kendelle
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Joins as a core player; her workstation crashes repeatedly, prompting a weekend repair pledge from Case.

lore_notes.fact: Reports his custom-built workstation is severely flawed, citing overheating and driver issues. [1:45:44]
Workstation suffers repeated crashes and a dead middle monitor; Case commits to fixing it over the weekend. [3:25:41]

episode_summary: Anchor Case Blackwell deviated from the nightly news format for a three-hour cooperative playthrough of the extraction horror game R.E.P.O., joined by contributor Kendelle and assorted guests. Technical difficulties with mods, Steam connectivity, and Kendall's crashing workstation plagued the session, though the crew eventually achieved high-strength loadouts and cleared multiple maps. Blackwell signed off promising a return to news programming Monday and a weekend repair effort for Kendall's workstation.
